name: Quick Web Apps
blurb: Web App Manager for the COSMIC™ desktop written with love and libcosmic.
description:
Web App Manager for the COSMIC™ desktop written with love and libcosmic. Allow you to simply create web applications from given url working inside separate window. With some customization options.

• Fast and easy to use

• Works out of the box

• In-app icon pack installer

• Supports WebKitGTK web engine

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
